app: User-interface text of HQminiMap, a desktop companion app for the city-building / transport video game Transport Fever 3. Its in-game mod exports the savegame's map; the app plans an in-game scan that takes top-down screenshot tiles, assembles them into an orthophoto (a georeferenced top-down image of the whole map), and a map viewer shows that image with live game data: transport lines, stations, vehicles, towns, industries and warehouses.

sections.lang: Name of the language in the language list.
sections.tabs: Main tabs of the app window.
sections.header: App header bar: progress of the orthophoto being computed, app update notice.
sections.updates: Options › Updates: checking GitHub releases and installing new versions of the app.
sections.updates.err: Options › Updates: why the update check failed.
sections.steps: Steps bar at the top of the app: export the map in game, scan it, compute the orthophoto.
sections.map: Reading the map exported by the mod (map.lua, heightmap.lua files).
sections.grid: GridLab tab: plans the in-game scan (camera altitude, field of view, grid of screenshot tiles covering the map, lighting) and starts it in the game.
sections.grid.status: GridLab: status line about the exported map and the last scan.
sections.grid.mode: GridLab: capture mode, i.e. how many screenshots (detail level) the scan takes.
sections.grid.summary: GridLab: summary of the current capture session.
sections.grid.auto: GridLab: automatic orthophoto computation after a capture.
sections.grid.view: GridLab: switch between the grid planner and the list of captures.
sections.grid.d: GridLab › Details: settings computed automatically for the chosen mode.
sections.grid.r: GridLab › Details: expected result of the scan (images, ground resolution, final orthophoto, coverage, sun glint).
sections.grid.block: GridLab: why the scan cannot be started (shown after a dash).
sections.tiles: GridLab › Captures: screenshots collected from a scan (a run) and computation of the orthophoto from them.
sections.tiles.interp: GridLab › Captures: resampling filter used to compute the orthophoto.
sections.ortho.err: Why the orthophoto computation stopped (short, after a colon).
sections.viewer: Viewer tab: interactive map showing the orthophoto and the live game data.
sections.settings: Options tab: language, game data folder, installed mod folder.
sections.settings.map: Options › Map: display settings of the Viewer map (icon size, text size, line width, loads on vehicles).
sections.live: Options › Live data: which game data the mod exports and how often (seconds).
sections.lp: Viewer › Layers and filters panel: map layers (towns, industries, warehouses, stations, lines, vehicles), filters and saved filter configurations.
sections.lp.mode: Viewer › Layers panel: transport mode of a line.
sections.lp.kind: Viewer › Layers panel: what a line or station carries.
sections.lp.relief: Viewer › Layers panel › Relief layer: terrain colours by altitude and contour lines.
sections.lp.legend: Viewer › Layers panel: map legend entries.
sections.lp.labels: Viewer › Layers panel: which text labels are drawn on the map.
sections.lp.basemap: Viewer › Layers panel: background of the map (orthophoto image or plain black).
sections.lp.stop: Viewer › Layers panel: kind of station or stop.
sections.card: Viewer: information card of the object selected on the map (town, industry, warehouse, station, line, vehicle).
sections.tp: Viewer: moving the in-game camera to the clicked place (teleport).
sections.export: Viewer: exporting the current map view as a PNG image.
sections.image: Viewer › Image menu: brightness, contrast, saturation and gamma of the orthophoto.
sections.stock: Viewer: kind of stock of an industry (input it consumes, output it produces, storage).
sections.history: Options › Capture history: list of past capture sessions with their size on disk, deletion.
sections.perf: Viewer: performance controller that simplifies the map display when too much is shown.
sections.mod: In-game window of the HQminiMap mod inside Transport Fever 3 (status line and its button).
